flags.message: Conservative disclosure: searches to locate the pre-baseline Anderson/Intel circuit opinion incidentally surfaced a commentator's bottom-line expectation concerning related Intel litigation, plus later snippets mentioning government briefing in Parker-Hannifin. The related-case forecast is not a forecast of this cell. I did not open the commentary pages, infer the SG recommendation, or use those bottom lines; substantive external reliance is confined to the May 2025 Anderson and England circuit opinions. No own-case disposition was sought or knowingly incorporated. Context designates forward mode, so later non-outcome material is not itself replay leakage.
